label: CloakBrowser
description: CloakBrowser as a browser engine for VibeSpace's agent browser: a Chromium build that sites are less likely to block as a bot. You install CloakBrowser from its maker and paste its program file into this plugin's settings; VibeSpace checks that program, measures its version and runs it inside an allowlisting proxy: it reaches only the sites you list. Not affiliated with CloakHQ: the browser is theirs, under https://github.com/CloakHQ/CloakBrowser/blob/main/BINARY-LICENSE.md

settings.label: Program file
settings.description: The CloakBrowser program (its chrome file) — required. Install CloakBrowser the way its maker says, then paste the path here: "cloakbrowser install" prints it. VibeSpace checks that the file exists and runs, measures its version, and starts it inside its allowlisting proxy.

settings.label: Sites it may open (host names, comma-separated)
settings.description: The only sites this browser may reach, through VibeSpace's allowlisting proxy: exact host names, or ".example.com" for a domain and all its sub-domains. Empty (default): it opens no site at all. CloakBrowser needs no site of its own. Loopback and link-local addresses are never admitted.
